verdict.rationale: A probe confirms NVIDIA serves an llms.txt at developer.nvidia.com, a portal covering the CUDA Toolkit and related tools for this GPU, so an agent has a documented entry point. However, it is a general portal index rather than RTX 5080-specific agent docs, and the markdown docs variant returns 404. Missing for 10: product-specific agent-oriented docs, markdown/plain-text doc pages (cuda-toolkit.md 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent usability.
